$comment: WebVoyager 公开基准测试 10 题, Phase 2.0D 基线。来源: github.com/MinorJerry/WebVoyager

tasks.instruction: Search for 'mechanical keyboard' and find the first result's price.
Search for 'laptop' and report the number of results shown.
tasks.success_criteria: extract_text returns a number with 'results' or 'items'

tasks.instruction: Search for hotels in New York for next month, 1 adult, 1 night.
tasks.success_criteria: URL contains 'searchresults' or page title contains 'New York'

tasks.instruction: Search for one-way flights from NYC to LAX for tomorrow.
tasks.success_criteria: URL contains 'flights/search' OR page contains flight results

tasks.instruction: Search for 'playwright' repositories and report the star count of the top result.
Find the headline of the top story and report it.
tasks.success_criteria: extract_text returns a non-empty headline string (length > 10)

tasks.instruction: Report the title and score of the top story.
tasks.success_criteria: extract_text returns text containing both a title and a number (score)

tasks.instruction: Search for 'Large language model' and report the first paragraph text.
Compute 'integral of x^2 dx' and report the result.
Search for restaurants in San Francisco for tonight, 2 people.
tasks.success_criteria: URL contains 'restaurants' or page contains restaurant list
